Seal-fingerprint gap, measured 2026-11-19 in wt-1e99. test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py loads cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py dynamically (_sail()), so sail.py is outside the proof's recorded closure. After the fix commit f09284b4f, the commit-time reseal kept the red seal as 'settled, closure has not moved' (Law 1). Only an explicit bin/cairn test --seal re-ran it green. A code change to a dynamically loaded subject leaves its seal standing. No ticket covers this: greps over closure+dynamic found 734b22d09f2e (PROVED, a seal records what it reached) and cfb4cb45d85c (sys.path order), neither of which is this gap.
